name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-pre-credits-font
title: Super Mario World - Pre-Credits Font
description:
This is the font used on the pre-credits scene (when you rescue Peach) that bears a striking resemblance to the classic NES font used in games like SMB1. The font in the final game doesn't contain all uppercase letters (since it doesn't need to), but a full font set (that perfectly matches up with the message box font, no less!) was found among the many other early smw graphics in the 2020 gigaleak. Perhaps this was the original English message font?
Nevetheless, it's still a pretty nice font, so now you can use it in your romhacks if you so please!

The ILLUSIYELLOW text is unchanged. The numbers have been replaced by those from the SMB1 font as no equivalent exists in the leaked font afaik.
For convenience's sake, the leftover Japanese question/exclamation marks have been replaced by an 8 and 9.

No credit needed!
